txt: In 6 minutes, the Sun rises in the west.
[TITULO] What If Earth Spun Slower and Couldn't Stop?
The equator. A normal day.
The ground under you moves at 1,037 mph.
Then Earth starts spinning slower.
And it doesn't stop.
Every day lasts a little longer.
A day is only two hours longer. That's enough.
The oceans start flowing away from the equator.
The sea is pulling back from the beach.
It isn't the tide. It isn't coming back.
The sea floor is drying in the sun.
Cannon Beach, Oregon. Far to the north.
Here, the water is coming in.
And something is building out at sea.
New York City.
The oceans are flowing north.
Toward the poles. Toward here.
All at once.
From space, you can see it turning slower.
The oceans have left the equator.
A new continent is rising around the middle of the planet.
A day now lasts more than three days.
San Francisco, days later.
The water is leaving here too.
Still flowing toward the poles.
The Golden Gate is standing on dry land.
Santa Monica.
The afternoon won't end.
The Sun barely moves across the sky.
A day now lasts two weeks.
Then the night comes.
It lasts for weeks.
With no sunlight, everything freezes.
A day now lasts two months.
From space, Earth barely turns.
One side bakes in a day that lasts for months.
The other side freezes in the dark.
The equator moves slower than a bicycle.
Back at the equator.
The ground moves at walking pace.
And then the Sun stops.
It hangs in the sky. It isn't setting.
Earth is still slowing down.
Then the Sun starts to move again.
Backwards. Toward the east.
It's setting in the east.
Earth has stopped turning.
For the first time, it isn't spinning at all.
Then it starts turning the other way.
And it doesn't stop.
The equator. The next morning.
Every sunrise you've ever seen was in the east.
Not this one.
The Sun is rising in the west.
Earth spins faster and faster. Backwards.
And the oceans flow back to the equator.
All of them.
At once.
[TELA] You started on a 24-hour day.
[TELA] Is any of this real?

[TELA] The numbers are real: the equator moves at 1,037 mph today. Spin slower, and the oceans flow away from the equator. If Earth stopped spinning, they would gather in two oceans at the poles, around one continent wrapped round the middle. Spinning once a year, the Sun would stand still in the sky; not spinning at all, it would rise in the west once a year. Venus spins backwards, so slowly that one turn takes longer than its year. How fast the water moves here is a guess.
[TELA] Which what if should we do next? Tell us in the comments.
[TELA] Now watch what happens if Earth spun faster.
